utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That's wonderful, Tess! Every bit helps. We're going to have a great turnout!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, sounds like it's shaping up to be a busy day! Hope I can make it on time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: No worries, Dane! If you're running late, just come when you can—we'll be there all day!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Nell, is the repair drive definitely this Saturday? I want to mark it on my calendar.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, Eli, it's this Saturday at the community center. I'm planning to be there too!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, glad that's settled. Do you know what supplies we still need? I can check my shed for rope or tools.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Kira, are you free to help with the repair drive this Saturday? I'm trying to get a headcount.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, the repair drive? You mean the one where they fix things for free? Are you sure that's actually happening?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, it's definitely happening! Saturday morning—I just need to know if you can join so I can finalize the start time.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, was it bikes or fences? I keep losing track.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: It's fences, Noah. And we're still hunting down tarps and rope in case it rains.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, fences! Right. I can check my shed for some rope, but no promises I'll remember where I put it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Vik, have we confirmed the date for the repair drive? I thought it was this Saturday, but I want to make sure we're all on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, Pia, it's this Saturday! We're meeting at my garage at 9 AM to fix up bikes for kids at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's good to know, but do we have enough volunteers and supplies to actually get everything done? I'm worried one drive might not cover all the repairs we need.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Hana, have you heard about the repair drive this weekend at the community center? I'm bringing my old toaster!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh great, Tess! A toaster sounds perfect. I'm glad it's for electronics—I was worried I'd need to bring fence post rope or something.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, I'm excited! I also have a shirt with a torn seam—they're fixing clothes too. What are you bringing?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what exactly is this repair drive about?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, it's something about fixing bikes for the kids, I think. But don't quote me on that—I lost my notes again!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Well, do you know where I can sign up to help with that bike fixing?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Mara, I caught wind of the repair drive. Might swing by if I get a chance.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That'd be great, Bo! It's shaping up nicely—Gus has a van full of tools, and we've got a good crew. Hope you can make it!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I'll try to pop by if work doesn't run late.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The repair drive is this Sunday at the community center parking lot, from 10 to 2. I've got it all confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, I thought it was Saturday—let me check with Faye to make sure we're on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I'm sure it's Sunday, Jules. Rosa mentioned the change earlier.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I'll be there Saturday morning with my tools.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Leo, that's great you're bringing your tools! Just a heads up, the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center, same time, 10 to 2. Hope you can still make it!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sunday works for me. I'll be there at 10.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I hope it goes well for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Me too. Every little bit helps.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah... I'll be cheering you all on from my porch.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Gus, I keep hearing about this repair drive but I'm getting mixed signals—bikes, fences, school stuff. Can you set me straight?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Ira! The repair drive is this Saturday—people bring broken stuff like bikes, fences, school supplies, and we fix 'em up together. I've got a van full of tools if you or anyone needs help!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, got it! So it's like a community fix-up day. I might have a broken chair—can I bring that too?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Vik, heard you're working on the repair drive—I've got a van full of tools if you need anything!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, that's perfect, Gus! We're fixing bikes for kids this Saturday at my garage at 9 AM—we can definitely use those tools!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds great, Vik! I'll bring the van over Saturday morning—anything specific you need besides wrenches and tire levers?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I'm glad we're doing this—every little bit helps.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yeah, especially if it keeps electronics out of the landfill.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Exactly, and if we can teach people to fix things themselves, it'll last even longer.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I'll bring my own tools Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's great, Leo! Every bit helps—we'll have plenty of tools to go around.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good, see you Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I'm still waiting on Leo to get back to me about the date. Maybe you could check with him?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure, I can ask Leo about it. I'll let you know what he says.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Dane. I appreciate you helping out with that.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Kira! Are you planning to come to the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: The repair drive? You mean the one where they claim to fix things for free? What makes you think that's actually going to work?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, I totally get the skepticism, but last time they helped fix my blender and Mrs. Chen's toaster! It's run by skilled volunteers from the tech collective.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, it's Saturday 10-2 at the community center. Just bring anything busted.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Actually, Bo, I think it's Sunday, not Saturday. Rosa told me Sunday at the community center, and I confirmed with Eli it's in the parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, my bad. Sunday it is then. See you there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Nell, are you coming to the repair drive this weekend? I'm bringing my toaster!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: A toaster? That's great! I was wondering if we'd have enough tools—I'm hoping to borrow a hammer from Gus.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Gus is bringing tools—I'm sure he'll have a hammer you can borrow!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, what exactly is this repair drive about?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Honestly, I'm a bit confused too. I think it's for fixing bikes for kids, but I've heard other things too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, is it definitely bikes? And where's the sign-up sheet for that?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Oren, are you coming to the repair drive this Saturday? We're fixing bikes for kids!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: The repair drive? Oh, I think I left my notes somewhere... let me check.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: No worries, Oren! It's this Saturday at the community center. We'd love to have you there!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Uli, that's a shame you can't make it. It's been moved to Sunday at the community center, so if your schedule changes, you're still welcome!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I appreciate the update, but I think I'll still have to pass. Thanks for thinking of me though.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Well, I understand, Uli. Take care, and hopefully we'll see you at the next one!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes Mina, that sign-up sheet is for the repair drive this Saturday. We're still sorting out the start time, but Leo already signed up for the morning.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday, good. But we need a fixed start time. Have we set that yet?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Not yet, Eli. I'm waiting to hear back from a couple more people, but I'll set a time as soon as I do.
